nodes.name: Validate Intake
nodes.notes: Shared secret (constant time) or HubSpot v3 signature, event extraction and 24-hour event-ID de-duplication. Needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto.

nodes.name: Raise If Misconfigured
nodes.notes: Fails the execution after a 503, so the error branch alerts.

nodes.name: Build Manual Batch
nodes.notes: Demo: bundled events. HubSpot mode: MANUAL_TEST_DEAL_IDS (latest stage change of each deal).

nodes.name: Load Config & Route
nodes.notes: Validates configuration and pins one clock for the run.

nodes.name: Run Demo Audit
nodes.notes: Bundled fictional deals behind a mock HubSpot. No network.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Account Details
nodes.notes: GET /account-info/v3/details for the sandbox check.

nodes.name: Enforce Sandbox & Plan Reads
nodes.notes: Stops unless the portal is a sandbox or developer test account (SANDBOX_MODE=true).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Deal Pipelines
nodes.notes: GET /crm/v3/pipelines/deals. Stage order comes from displayOrder.

nodes.name: HubSpot: List Owners
nodes.notes: GET /crm/v3/owners (paginated) to resolve owner and "changed by" names.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Deal With Stage History
nodes.notes: Deal properties plus dealstage and reason history (propertiesWithHistory). An unreadable deal is reported, the rest continue.

nodes.name: Detect Stage Regressions
nodes.notes: Finds the stage change in history, compares stage order and checks the regression reason.

nodes.name: Wait for Regression Reason
nodes.notes: Gives the rep REASON_GRACE_MINUTES to fill in the reason before it counts as missing.

nodes.name: Build Audit Records
nodes.notes: Builds audit records and upserts them into the static-data table.

nodes.name: Plan Audit Table Writes
nodes.notes: Airtable upserts only when AUDIT_TABLE_PROVIDER=airtable and DRY_RUN=false.

nodes.name: Audit Table: Upsert Rows (Airtable)
nodes.notes: Upsert keyed on "Audit Key": retried webhooks never duplicate rows.

nodes.name: Plan Owner Tasks
nodes.notes: One owner task per regression without a valid reason (CREATE_OWNER_TASKS=true, DRY_RUN=false).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Create Owner Task
nodes.notes: POST /crm/v3/objects/tasks associated with the deal (type 216).

nodes.name: Build Leadership Alert
nodes.notes: Applies ALERT_MIN_SEVERITY, ALERT_MIN_AMOUNT and ALERT_ONLY_MISSING_REASON and picks the Slack target.

nodes.name: Slack: Notify Sales Leadership
nodes.notes: The webhook URL is read from $env at request time. Swap for an email node if leadership prefers email.

nodes.name: Finalize Run
nodes.notes: Daily counters, run summary, and a failed execution when any audit row or owner task failed.

nodes.name: Build Redacted Failure Alert
nodes.notes: Redacts tokens, secrets and webhook URLs before alerting.

parameters.content:
## Deal stage regression audit logger: safety defaults
- **Demo mode** while HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_TOKEN is a placeholder: bundled fictional deals, no network.
- **DRY_RUN=true**: detects and logs to n8n static data; no HubSpot tasks, no Airtable rows.
- **SANDBOX_MODE=true**: refuses production portals; Slack goes only to SLACK_SANDBOX_WEBHOOK_URL.
- Webhook auth: shared secret (constant time) or HubSpot v3 signature. Event IDs are de-duplicated.
- Reason grace period: regressions without a reason are re-checked after REASON_GRACE_MINUTES.
- Failure alerts are redacted.
